proposed_comments.body:
### Publish the Ctrl-bypass setting to the injector safely

**Severity:** `medium`

The timer-side cancellation must honor `ignore_with_ctrl=false` as well. Copy the option while holding `g_momentumMutex`, rather than reading the hook thread's `g_settings` directly from the injector; the companion timer change reads this copy under the same mutex.

```suggestion
        std::scoped_lock lock(g_momentumMutex);
        g_injectorIgnoreWithCtrl = settings.ignoreWithCtrl;
```

Apply all three suggestions in this group as one batch; they form one Ctrl-cancellation correction.

proposed_comments.body:
### Keep the injector's Ctrl-bypass policy under its state mutex

**Severity:** `medium`

The Ctrl cancellation change needs a policy copy shared by `ApplySettings` and the injector timer. Place it with the state guarded by `g_momentumMutex`; the companion suggestions update and read it under that mutex, preserving the configured Ctrl-bypass behavior without introducing a cross-thread settings read.

```suggestion
    std::mutex g_momentumMutex;
    bool g_injectorIgnoreWithCtrl = true;
```

Apply all three suggestions in this group as one batch; they form one Ctrl-cancellation correction.
